mathematics.assertion_tested: For S_chi = integral sqrt(-g) F(Y) on a flat static three-leaf, derive the constitutive flux and traceless stress; test whether exact exponential MOND and pointwise Phi=Psi can coexist for every nonzero gradient.
mathematics.action_sector: Y = delta^ij partial_i chi partial_j chi; no multiplier/heat stress, disformal metric, background vector gradient, or extra tensor operator.
mathematics.exact_identity: sum_ij (v_i v_j - delta_ij Y/3)^2 = 2 Y^2/3, with Y=sum_i v_i^2
mathematics.scope: Conditional obstruction only; not a universal no-go for nonlocal, constrained, or multi-field stress cancellation.
non_claims: No full covariant clock/heat action variation
No Dirac constraint count or propagating-DOF theorem
No PPN, FLRW, CMB, stability, or galaxy fit
No claim about actions with additional metric stress that cancels Pi_ij
No claim at the degenerate Y=0 point
